comparison.objective: Move a heavy upright carton onto a low platform using the step edge as a pivot.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load control, leading-edge placement, pushing, and pivoting between levels.
comparison.success_condition: Carton fully flat and released on platform for 1 s; staged credit for bridging/overhang; >20° tilt at any time zeros.
comparison.reason: Tests level change and pivoting of one heavy load, not selective separation of small bodies.
